title: polyscias sambucifolia
intro: Polyscias sambucifolia, commonly known as Elder's Tea, is a plant species that belongs to the family Araliaceae and is native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help in alleviating fever, cough, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Polyscias sambucifolia include its analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating pain, reducing fever, and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
